description: System during-template pin — running 120 min, moderate gut. Tests that a template solver fixture with an explicit template definition fires correctly and produces valid foods.
knownFailureReason: CONFIRMED on real dev catalog: template solver for 'Gel + Water' returns null (carbs 83%, 50g/60g). The real catalog energy_gel has max_per_hr_moderate=3, min_increment=1, is_indivisible=false — the template distribution over 120min at moderate gut yields 2 gels/hr × 2hr × 25g = 50g carbs, which falls below the 90% validation threshold (54g). The synthetic catalog had max_per_hr_moderate=3 and different rounding, yielding exactly 60g. This is a template solver constraint rounding issue exposed by real per-hr caps from the production catalog.
